would like to give Zero stars, terrible receptionist service. The employee simply looks at her with a mocking face when asked for help as a patient and this is unacceptable because she is well paid for this.

I clearly realized from my situation and that of other people how it is even more difficult for immigrants to be treated with dignity.

I don't usually do assessments of this type, but the situation is really precarious in that reception building and they really need training to learn to respect people based on their professional positions.

I've been trying to schedule an appointment with the doctor for over 24 hours and I still haven't been successful due to the bureaucracy of online forms, which instead of helping, make the situation even more difficult while receptionists shirk their own responsibilities.

I hope this feedback reaches the person in charge and that they seek improvements for the population, who go to GPs because they really need help.
